title: Host Protect
subtitle: On-box web malware control plane. Not Guard and not SIEM.
featureOff: Host Protect is not enabled in this environment.
emptyHint: Register a document root on a Guard agent. Scans stay on the host; hits are not mixed with IP/domain findings.
name: Name
intervalHint: Hourly is optional. Beat still caps two in-flight scans per organization. Jail stays the document root — never YARA on /.
limitReached: Site limit reached for this SKU.
hitsWaitingAgent: Still checking on your server. Results are not in yet — do not treat this as clean.
hitsClean: No suspicious files in the folder it could check (up to 500 files, 1 MB each). This is not a guarantee for the whole server.
hitsHidden: Ignored files are hidden. Use Show ignored files to open the list. That does not mean the site is clean.
hitsUnlisted: This check recorded findings, but none appear in this list. Try Scan now. That does not mean the site is clean.
hitsUnreachable: The check did not finish on your server. Results appear only after that check sends them back.
scanQueued: Still checking on your server. Results are not in yet.
scanCompleted: Check finished. {{count}} file(s) still need a decision (quarantine or ignore).
scanCompletedNone: Check finished. No suspicious files in the folder it could check.
scanCompletedIgnored: Check finished. {{count}} file(s) match what you already marked Ignore — nothing new to decide.
scanCompletedUnlisted: Check finished. Findings were recorded but are not in this list. Try Scan now.
noAgents: Install a Guard agent first, then register a site here.
helperRequired: Adding a site does not scan the disk. Install the Host Protect helper on the Guard VPS (timer + token). Without a recent helper poll, Scan now fails closed.
helperNeverPolled: Helper has not polled this agent yet.
helperStale: Helper last polled {{when}} — older than 30 minutes. Scan now may fail until the helper runs again.
installHint: On the Guard VPS, download one file. Do not clone the repo. Do not pipe curl into bash.
installCheck: The first line must start with #! — if you see <!DOCTYPE html>, the download failed.
honestyHint: Results come from a check that runs on your server. A waiting or failed check is not a clean result.
installHint: Download one file. Do not clone the repo. Token stays the Guard enroll token.
installCheck: First line must start with #! — if you see HTML, the download failed.
helperStale: Helper last polled {{when}} (more than 30 minutes ago). Scan results may be stale.
statusPendingQuarantine: Queued for helper — not quarantined yet
statusPendingRestore: Restore queued — still quarantined on disk
wafHint: HTTP filter per site — not the Malware tab. Off: no filter, Simulate stays off. Detect: log only after the snippet is on the customer VPS. Protect (Host Multi): block there. Mode in this UI does not block sinexis.app. Never paste the snippet onto the public edge.
wafFeatureOff: Host WAF is not enabled in this environment.
wafNeedSite: Add a Host Protect site first, then set WAF mode.
wafProtectLocked: Protect mode needs Host Multi. Basic can use detect only.
wafSimulateHint: Preview only. Adds a sample row in this table so you can see the layout. It does not send a request to your site, does not scan files, and does not mean an attack happened. Turn mode to detect or protect first.
wafEventsHint: These rows are HTTP filter events, not Suspicious files. Simulate adds a preview only. Live rows appear after the helper posts matches from nginx on your VPS — not from this dashboard.
wafEventsEmpty: No WAF events yet. Simulate is preview only. Live hits need the snippet on the VPS plus a helper poll that posts them here.
wafCopyHint: Clipboard only. Paste the include on the customer VPS — this button does not install or reload nginx.
wafCopyOk: Snippet copied. Do not paste onto sinexis.app edge nginx.
